attrs.evidence: Fable 5 proposed C9 as 'no transfer out of SINK AND no refill after exhaustion'. The second half over-corrects: with a global cap of 10 and 5 already spent, moving the remaining 5 to an account cannot make the world less private than the cap already permits. The narrowing is GPT-5.6's and is asserted positively by the law, so a future tightening to Fable's version fails the suite rather than passing it silently.
attrs.statement: Irreversibility forbids RECOVERING spent value; it does not forbid ALLOCATING unspent budget. A TREASURY → account transfer of an irreversible resource remains feasible.
